title: glaucoma-AFO: an R pipeline for multi-omics analysis of trabecular meshwork mechanotransduction and extracellular matrix remodelling in primary open-angle glaucoma
description:
A numbered R pipeline (steps 00-17) for an integrative, dry-laboratory study of primary open-angle glaucoma. Starting from public bulk trabecular meshwork transcriptomes, single-cell atlases of the outflow pathway, eQTL/pQTL resources and GWAS summary statistics, the pipeline runs differential expression, WGCNA, pathway-activity and deconvolution modelling, machine-learning signature construction with Harrell optimism correction, single-cell and cell-cell communication analysis, cross-species concordance, colocalisation, TWAS, two-sample and mediation Mendelian randomisation, in silico gene perturbation with label-permutation and multiverse robustness checks, and finally writes a results ledger that maps every number reported in the manuscript back to the output file and field from which it was derived.

All steps are driven by a single YAML configuration file. A synthetic demo dataset (99_demo_data.R) reproduces the whole chain without downloading any real data. Raw data are not redistributed here; accessions and expected file locations are listed in the README.
